title: AnsysEM candidate workspace begin and abort without version proliferation
prompt: Use exactly four EDA Bridge Runtime tool calls, all eda.submit on connection '{{ANSYS_CONNECTION}}'. Do not call capabilities or any other tool. First create a disposable source with purpose 'Create source for candidate lifecycle evaluation', operation project.create, idempotency_key='{{ANSYS_CREATE_KEY}}', payload project='{{ANSYS_SOURCE_PROJECT}}', design='CandidateEvalLayout', version='2026.1', profile='aedt-2026r1-display4', display=':4.0', redact_paths=true, and wait={timeout_ms:90000,poll_interval_ms:1000}. Second begin one candidate with purpose 'Begin candidate without permanent revision', operation workspace.begin, idempotency_key='{{ANSYS_BEGIN_KEY}}', payload source='{{ANSYS_SOURCE_PROJECT}}', workspace='{{ANSYS_WORKSPACE}}', adapter='hfss3dlayout.native/v1', version='2026.1', design='CandidateEvalLayout', profile='aedt-2026r1-display4', redact_paths=true, and the same wait. Read the exact workspace_revision from that terminal response. Third abort it with purpose 'Abort owned candidate using observed revision', operation workspace.abort, idempotency_key='{{ANSYS_ABORT_KEY}}', payload workspace='{{ANSYS_WORKSPACE}}', expected_workspace_revision equal to the exact observed revision, redact_paths=true, and the same wait. Fourth inspect the frozen source with purpose 'Verify source after candidate abort', operation project.inspect, idempotency_key='{{ANSYS_INSPECT_KEY}}', payload project='{{ANSYS_SOURCE_PROJECT}}', redact_paths=true, and the same wait. Do not replay, use shell/files/documentation/GUI/arbitrary code, reconcile, promote, create an output revision, solve, or access customer data. From the actual responses return only compact JSON with status='passed', source_bundle_complete=true, workspace_aborted=true, candidate_removed=true, source_unchanged=true, permanent_output_created=false, and solve_run=false.
